يستنسبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْسِبُوا (yastansibū) /jas.tan.si.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْسَبَ (istansaba)
# يُسْتَنْسَبُوا (yustansabū) /jus.tan.sa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْسَبَ (istansaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
